claim.summary: For any field F, commutative F-algebra R, n>=1 and upper triangular (n+1)-matrices A,B, psi_n:x->A*x,y->B*(x+y) sends H_d^d, H_d=[x,y]x^(d-2), to a matrix polynomial with every y-degree j<n word coefficient zero when d>=max(2,2n). Each coefficient lies in J^(d-j) for j<=d, J strictly upper triangular. H_d^d is nonzero homogeneous degree d² and has size O(d²), ordered unbounded-fanin depth<=5. H_d^d+K_d^d,K_d=[x,y]y^(d-2), has same properties for d>=max(3,2n). Invertible a=x+y,b=x+lambda*y with lambda not0,1 gives dense nonzero leaf coefficients, e.g. overF4. One-channel source form w1=2,w2=1 gives ell2=2 and d>=4; two-channel w1=4,w2=2,c=(1,1),c1 with rows(1,-1,0,0),(0,0,1,-1) gives ell2=6,d>=12, refuting Lakhani-Saxena ECCC TR26-173 Lemma4.10's printed backward implication. The final tensor-upper-triangular detector also vanishes for d>=2n+1 since (J tensor T+T tensor J)^(2n+1)=0. For even d>=4, binary X=I+E12,Y=E21 gives the two-channel polynomial value I2, so no refutation of the main abstract matrix-witness theorem, IPS bound or hard-formula family is claimed.
